controlTable.status: legacy atlas-data.js provenance; no longer the displayed ROM control definition

bodyLabels: Visible mesh labels use the exact target OpenSim Body names. The public visual meshes lunate, scaphoid, pisiform and triquetrum all map to the target model's single proximal_row body. Bodies outside the displayed hand and non-surface carrier bodies are not invented as visible meshes.
rendering: Joint names, coordinate names, coordinate ranges, 43 Muscle names, CMC coupling, and default-pose moment-arm associations come from the target WSY OpenSim model. The public MyoHand surface and tendon paths remain a visual reference. ROM uses prescribed display kinematics with MyoHand anchors/axes and approximate route blending; it is not a WSY mesh export, muscle-force simulation, collision solver, or browser-native OpenSim solve. The target model has no independent thumb MCP ab/adduction coordinate, so that former constructed control is not displayed.
